summary: Perfect Corp. filed a 6-K announcing that the Special Committee of the Board has appointed Kroll as financial advisor and DLA Piper as international legal counsel to evaluate a preliminary non-binding proposal received on March 18, 2026. The proposal terms are not disclosed, and no definitive offer or agreement has been made. The Special Committee is continuing its review. Board cautions no decision has been reached. This is a strategic review-driven process, akin to a US 'go-shop' or special committee evaluation. Watch for material definitive agreements or proposal updates; risk-arb spread reflects deal uncertainty.
